title: Partner Poke Pressure Dribble
description: A partner tries to poke the ball while the dribbler protects it in place with the body, the off arm and a low dribble.

content.objective: Protect a live dribble from a defender's hands using the body, the off arm and the dribble height.
content.setup: Pairs with one ball; the dribbler stands in a box about two metres square.
instructions: The dribbler starts low in a box, the partner one arm-length away.
On the whistle, the partner tries to touch the ball with either hand.
The dribbler may move within the box, change hands and turn the body.
Count the number of touches the partner gets in 30 seconds.
coachingPoints: Off arm up as a bar, not pushing.
Body between partner and ball at all times.
Lower dribble the closer the partner gets.
commonMistakes: Pushing the partner away with the off arm (foul).
Turning the back fully and losing vision.
Dribbling high in front of the body.
content.safety: Pokers touch the ball only; no slapping arms or reaching across the body.
regressions: Allow a 1-second hold every five dribbles.
variations: Weak hand only for the dribbler.
Dribbler must also keep one foot in a hoop or square.
successCriteria: Fewer than three touches conceded in 30 seconds.
No offensive fouls with the off arm.
content.gameApplication: Ball protection under a reaching defender prevents most backcourt and trap turnovers.
